# Costa Mesa Jiu Jitsu

> Brazilian Jiu Jitsu gym for kids (from age 4) and adults at 2428 Newport Blvd, Costa Mesa, CA 92627 (Orange County). Gi and NoGi classes, a 6-week beginners program, private lessons, free open mats Friday night and Saturday, and a free first class. Call or text 949-556-1178. Email info@costamesajiujitsu.com.

## Key facts
- Location: 2428 Newport Blvd, Costa Mesa, California 92627
- Programs: Little Ninjas (ages 4 to 6), Youth Jiu Jitsu (ages 7 to 12), adult Gi and NoGi Jiu Jitsu, free Open Mats Friday night and Saturday
- Head coach: Tony Misitano, Brazilian Jiu Jitsu black belt. Black belt coaching every class.
- First class: free for kids and adults
- Private lessons: 1 to 4 people per lesson, groups split the cost. Parent and kid lessons and family lessons are popular.
- Beginners Jiu Jitsu Program: 6 weeks for $99. Meets Tuesdays at 6:15 PM in the beginner-friendly NoGi class. Join any week; your 6 weeks start at your first class.
- Memberships: Unlimited Adult $195/month, Unlimited Kids $195/month, Family Add-On $120/month, 10-Class Pack $260 one time
- Booking, memberships and payments: the member portal at https://eldojo.ossdojo.com/member

## Weekly jiu jitsu schedule
- Monday: Little Ninjas 3:30 PM, Youth 4:30 PM, Adult NoGi 5:30 PM
- Tuesday: Little Ninjas 4:15 PM, Youth NoGi 5:00 PM, Adult NoGi (beginner friendly) 6:15 PM
- Thursday: Little Ninjas 4:15 PM, Youth 5:00 PM, Adult Gi 6:15 PM
- Friday: Little Ninjas 4:15 PM, Youth NoGi 5:00 PM, Open Mat 6:00 PM (free for everyone)
- Saturday: Open Mat 12:00 PM (free for everyone)
